A '''light shaper''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] technology used to send and receive messages. It used [[villip]]s to create a [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|254, 256|light shaper}}</ref>
